intro: Government and technology organisations across the United States and North America were the primary focus of the 21 CISA-related reports published between April and September 2026. The coverage, which includes four critical and 15 high-severity incidents, references threat actors GRU, Interlock, and Lazarus Group as separate entities. Key vulnerabilities documented include CVE-2024-57726, CVE-2026-60004, CVE-2026-21643, CVE-2026-34197, and CVE-2024-1708, with impacts noted across critical infrastructure, defense, software development, Brazil, the EU, and globally.
